preconditions.name: zworld_random_proj::post_bc_install_took
preconditions.description: The BC install took on this arm before RL: post_bc_foraging_competence (measured pre-RL, post warm-start) clears the 1.0 floor on the WORST seed. An install that did not take carries no installed prior; the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue when NEITHER arm installs, or records an asymmetric-install ADVANTAGE finding when only one does. Per-arm and NON-vacating: a non-installing control never vacates the trained arm's valid result.
preconditions.control: post-BC / pre-RL foraging_competence of this arm's worst seed vs the 1.0 floor

preconditions.name: zworld_trained::zworld_world_encoder_trained
preconditions.description: P0a warmup moved at least one split_encoder.world_encoder tensor (max|delta| > 0), i.e. z_world is a PREDICTION-TRAINED encoder rather than a frozen random projection. GATING on the TRAINED arm ONLY: a guard fire there means the treatment was not applied -> substrate_not_ready_requeue. SCOPED OUT of the random-projection CONTROL, where a frozen (untrained) encoder is the deliberate condition under test -- asserting training there would make the control's gate structurally un-passable and collapse the two-arm design.
preconditions.control: the SD-070 P0a warmup on the trained arm's own env at zworld_p0=60 -- the phase whose stated job is to train the world encoder

criteria.name: C_zworld_training_confers_competence_advantage
criteria.description: The prediction-trained z_world arm confers a reliable competence-trajectory advantage over the random-projection control: mean paired AUC delta >= the effect margin (max of 1.0 absolute and 0.15 of the control AUC) on a strict majority of seeds, OR it installs competence where the random projection cannot.

criteria.name: C_random_projection_provides_measured_baseline
criteria.description: The random-projection control installs and provides a measured baseline the trained arm is read against (the control that ran for sixteen legs).

anchor_reachability.reference_source: ree-v3 CLAUDE.md SD-070 ADOPTION note (substrate ree-v3 b523b9c70a, validated REE_assembly 25a69fcd4c 2026-07-22): split_encoder.world_encoder tensors move on every seed at zworld_p0_episodes=60, max_delta ~6.03e-03 (guard PASSES)

interpretation_grid.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchor is sub-floor, OR the trained arm's encoder did not train (treatment not applied), OR NEITHER arm installed
interpretation_grid.reading: UNINFORMATIVE about the z_world instrument. NEVER a scientific verdict and never substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional / does_not_support. Requeue.

interpretation_grid.label: zworld_prediction_training_confers_advantage
interpretation_grid.condition: the trained arm beats the random projection on the paired trajectory-AUC by the effect margin on a strict majority of seeds, OR installs where the random projection cannot
interpretation_grid.reading: Prediction-training the z_world encoder confers a competence advantage over a random projection of the same dimensionality: the representation is load-bearing for competence. The campaign's sixteen legs of z_world readings become re-interpretable against a substrate that can express them.

interpretation_grid.label: zworld_training_advantage_transient
interpretation_grid.condition: the trained arm's trajectory PEAK cleared the lift-competence target on a strict majority of seeds, but its terminal retained_fraction fell below the retention floor and no reliable terminal advantage remains
interpretation_grid.reading: The manipulation SUCCEEDED and then DECAYED -- prediction-training installs a competence that erodes under refinement. Read the trajectory and half-life, not the terminal scalar. This is the branch V3-EXQ-780's grid lacked.

interpretation_grid.label: zworld_training_harms_competence
interpretation_grid.condition: the trained arm is reliably WORSE than the random projection on the paired trajectory-AUC by the effect margin, OR the random projection installs where the trained encoder cannot
interpretation_grid.reading: Prediction-training the encoder HURT competence relative to a random projection (possible if the SD-070 recipe over-specialises or collapses the representation for the foraging task). Weakens the z_world-quality-helps-competence reading.

interpretation_grid.label: zworld_pathway_dispensable_for_competence
interpretation_grid.condition: both arms install and the trained arm neither reliably beats nor is beaten by the random projection (within the null band)
interpretation_grid.reading: THE INFORMATIVE NULL. Prediction-training confers NO competence advantage over a random projection -> the z_world pathway is DISPENSABLE for competence and INV-088's differentiation programme is reframed. Decisive in this direction, not weak evidence.

interpretation_grid.label: zworld_advantage_grid_nondiscriminative
interpretation_grid.condition: no arm passed its precondition gate, or the arms do not separate, or the readouts fall in none of the enumerated branches
interpretation_grid.reading: Not a refutation. Unscored; re-pose the measurement.
